in_marathi.name: Vini
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Graceful, kind, and gentle
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vini means 'gentle and kind' in Sanskrit and Hindi. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vana', which means 'forest' or 'woods'. The name evokes images of the delicate beauty and grace of nature. It is a name that is often given to girls who are gentle, kind, and compassionate.
